name: 透镜制造者公式计算器

map.由折射率与两表面曲率半径，按 1/f = (n-1)(1/R₁ - 1/R₂): From the refractive index and the radii of curvature of the two surfaces, compute the lens focal length using 1/f = (n-1)(1/R₁ - 1/R₂).
map.📖 查看「透镜制造者公式 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Lens Maker's Formula User Guide"
map.前表面曲率半径 R₁ (mm): Front surface radius of curvature R₁ (mm)
map.后表面曲率半径 R₂ (mm): Rear surface radius of curvature R₂ (mm)
map.符号约定：凸面 R>0、凹面 R<0（光线从左入射）。: Sign convention: convex surface R>0, concave surface R<0 (light entering from the left).
map.平凸透镜取 R₂=∞ 即可（代码中可填极大值近似）。: For a plano-convex lens, take R₂=∞ (enter a very large value as an approximation).
map.与两面曲率半径算焦距。: and the two radii of curvature, compute the focal length.
map.设计凸透镜/凹透镜屈光力。: Design the refractive power of convex/concave lenses.
map.验光片焦距反推曲率。: Infer curvature from the focal length of a trial lens.
map.曲率半径符号怎么定？: How is the sign of the radius of curvature determined?
map.光线从左到右，凸向入射面为正、凹向为负；符号错焦距正负反。: With light traveling left to right, a surface convex toward the incident light is positive, concave is negative; a sign error flips the sign of the focal length.
map.薄透镜才准吗？: Is it only accurate for thin lenses?
map.此式为薄透镜近似，厚透镜用矩阵/厚透镜公式，中心厚不可忽略时误差显。: This is a thin-lens approximation; thick lenses use matrix/thick-lens formulas, and the error becomes noticeable when the center thickness cannot be ignored.
